tools.name: search_circle_documentation
tools.description:
Use this tool to search the official Circle documentation for any information about the Circle developer suite.

NOTE:
  - You must use this tool FIRST to narrow your search scope, then use get_circle_product_summary to understand the relevant product.

query.description: Query to conduct a vector search in Circle's documentation.

tools.name: get_circle_product_summary
tools.description:
Get a summary of a specific Circle Web3 product and its capabilities.

Use this tool SECOND (after search_circle_documentation) to get detailed information about a specific Circle product including:
- Product description and use cases
- Supported blockchains
- Key features and capabilities
- When and how to use this product

Here's list of supported products and a quick summary of each:
- Developer-Controlled Wallets: Custodial wallets where developers manage user assets.
- User-Controlled Wallets: MPC-powered wallets where users control their private keys.
- Modular Wallets: A type of smart contract account wallet that can be extended with different modules, ideal for advanced / custom onchain wallets.
- Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP): Trust-minimized USDC bridging by burning on source and minting on target chains.
- Gateway: A unified USDC balance across multiple chains that allows users to spend USDC on any supported chain whenever they want.
- Smart Contract Platform (SCP): Deploy and manage smart contracts easily with Circle's templates or custom code.
Note: Developer-Controlled Wallets and User-Controlled Wallets were originally called Programmable Wallets (abbreviated as PW) but now both are called Circle Wallets.

product.description: The Circle Web3 product name to get a summary for.

tools.name: list_available_coding_resources
tools.description:
List all available coding resources for a specific Circle product.

Use this tool THIRD (after get_circle_product_summary) to understand what coding resources are available for implementation.

Returns a list of coding resources with:
- name: The identifier you'll use to retrieve the full resource details
- description: What the resource does
- resource_type: Either SDK_METHOD (TypeScript SDK methods) or CODE_SNIPPET (standalone code examples)

This helps you understand what's available before requesting full details with get_coding_resource_details.

product.description: The Circle Web3 product name to list coding resources for.

tools.name: get_coding_resource_details
tools.description:
Get detailed information about specific coding resources.

Use this tool FOURTH (after list_available_coding_resources) to retrieve the full content of coding resources.

Provide the resource names you got from list_available_coding_resources to get:
- Full description
- Complete content (code, documentation, metadata)
- Resource type

This gives you everything needed to implement functionality using Circle products.

resource_names.description: List of coding resource names to retrieve (from list_available_coding_resources).
